issue.title: Retire pluggable_finalizers
issue.description: Opt-in beta: SASE agent completion resolves host-owned pluggable finalizer plans instead of directly invoking the legacy commit finalizer.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Remove after the generic controller, built-in commit parity, declaration channel, plugin runtime, migration diagnostics, and documented soak gates have shipped without unexplained regressions.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Normal SASE agent completion continues to call the existing provider-neutral commit finalizer path without finalizer plan resolution.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Normal SASE agent completion resolves a sealed host-owned finalizer plan and routes through the beta pluggable finalizer controller.
